# Luke Harding

L H

Photo: © The Guardian

Luke Harding is an award-winning foreign correspondent with the _Guardian_ . He has reported from Delhi, Berlin and Moscow and has also covered wars in Afghanistan and Iraq. He is the author of _Mafia State_ and co-author of _WikiLeaks: Inside Julian Assange’s War on Secrecy_ (2011) and _The Liar: The Fall of Jonathan Aitken_ (1997), nominated for the Orwell Prize. The film rights to _WikiLeaks_ were sold to Dreamworks and the film, “The Fifth Estate,” came out in 2013. His books have been translated into 13 languages. Luke lives in England with his wife and their two children.
